actual_game_ui: Future source props without stable runtime placement or collision contract.

cells.subject: aster-reading-desk
cells.notes: Angled slate, fitted rotating pointer and open triangular support read as a working desk; connected bronze base and restrained light separate large planes.

cells.subject: neris-footbath
cells.notes: Crescent basin, attached step and shallow aqua surface are clear. The stone-like mosaic exterior is stronger than the requested glazed ceramic material; no fluid simulation is implied.

cells.subject: vesta-warming-bench
cells.notes: Heavy seat, supported legs, copper back plate and recessed coal drawer create a readable low warming bench, distinct from arena furnace monuments.

cells.subject: isen-resting-cradle
cells.notes: Curved stone support, open arch beneath and folded blue wool give a calm intimate prop. Small frost and fringe recede naturally at compact size.

cells.subject: nyra-curtain-frame
cells.notes: Offset rail, weighted plum drape, supported feet and visible folds read as cloth furniture. This resolves plum/cloth identity more clearly than the earlier rigid screen study; both originals remain retained.

aesthetic_acceptance: Optional candidates, one material caveat; user acceptance pending. No reroll.
